skills: Up to 5 Physical and Fire hits. The 5th binds the main target and enters Binding Seal.
Her DMG builds Burning Embers. Spending Embers on a Garrote or Decibels on an Ultimate gives 1 Burning Tether Point; at 3, her next Garrote becomes a lower-Interrupt Lunalux - Snare Chain Attack.
Hold at 50%+ Embers: spends 50% for a Fire slash (+1 Tether Point). 40% DMG reduction.
Keep holding after First Form at 50%+ Embers: spends 50% for a Fire follow-up (+1 Tether Point). 40% DMG reduction.
Garrote slash around her for Fire DMG; binds the main target into Binding Seal.
Garrote slash around her for Fire DMG; binds the main target into Binding Seal.
Parries an incoming attack for massive Daze.
Garrote slash and explosion for Fire DMG; binds the main target into Binding Seal.
Before Binding Seal: pulls the enemy in for a charging Fire kick that binds it into Binding Seal.

In Binding Seal: tethers nearby enemies to the bound one and detonates for Fire DMG, ending the Seal. Dodges as it starts; a Perfect Dodge gives +25% Embers. Press to cancel the blast into the 3rd Basic hit.
Stronger version for massive Fire DMG, with the same dodge, Ember bonus and cancel.
Many garrotes and an explosion for massive Fire DMG; binds the main target into Binding Seal.
Massive area Fire DMG, then Dance of Awakened Fire for the rest of the fight: Tether-Point Snares keep 1 Point. Binds the main target; +1 Tether Point.
Her later Ultimates: massive area Fire DMG; binds the main target; +1 Tether Point.

core.name: Entangle
core.text: Entering Binding Seal gives +{0}% CRIT Rate, kept for 10s after it ends. Switching out during Binding Seal auto-casts Binding Sunder - First Form.

ability.name: Ambush Point
ability.text: Chain and Ultimate DMG +30%. At 80%+ CRIT Rate, Lunalux - Snare and both Ultimates deal 125% of their normal multiplier.

mindscapes: Enters battle with 1,500 Decibels. Binding Seal targets are Bound: she ignores 12% of their DEF. Binding Sunder spreads Bound to everything it hits for 10s.
+15% ATK. Garrotes refund their Embers (once per 25s). Tether-Point Snares have higher Interrupt Level.
Chain or Ultimate gives a Shield of 10% Max HP; while it holds, +40% CRIT DMG.
Chain or Ultimate gives Shadowstring Edge for 20s: her Basic, Dash, Special and EX hits add a garrote for 375% ATK as Fire DMG, counted as Chain Attack DMG (up to 16 times).
